supported.intro: JoyoFit talks directly to compatible watches. Only one model has been tested on a real watch. See which watches are tested at fit.joyorogo.com/jam.
supported.footer: A watch that is not tested is still tried. Other watches, and earbuds, cannot be paired. JoyoFit is useful without a watch too: log strength workouts, use Coach and browse the exercise library.

intro.body: Strength logging, Coach and the exercise library work without a watch. A compatible watch adds steps, sleep, heart rate and daily readiness to Today.
